BitField.Name: ADDRESS_ASCENSION
BitField.Description: Address Ascension When Streaming. 0: address auto-decrements. 1: address auto-increments.

BitField.Name: LSB_FIRST
BitField.Description: I/O Data Oriented LSB First. 0: MSB first. 1: LSB first.

BitField.Name: SOFT_RESET
BitField.Description: Reset SPI Registers Except REG0000 to POR State. 0: normal operation. 1: soft reset.

BitField.Name: SINGLE_INSTRUCTION
BitField.Description: Single Instruction. 0: SPI streaming enabled. 1: SPI streaming disabled.

BitField.Name: MAIN_READBACK_CONTROL
BitField.Description: Main/Subordinate Readback Control. 0: readback subordinate register. 1: readback main register.

BitField.Name: N_INT_LSB
BitField.Description: 12-Bit Integer Word for N-Divider. Writing to Register 0x10 triggers autocalibration when EN_AUTOCAL = 1.

BitField.Name: RFOUT_DIV
BitField.Description: RFOUT Divider. 000: Divide by 1. 001: Divide by 2. 010: Divide by 4. 011: Divide by 8. 100: Divide by 16.

BitField.Name: INV_RFOUT
BitField.Description: Invert RFOUT1 and RFOUT2. 0: not inverted. 1: inverted.

BitField.Name: M_VCO_BAND_0
BitField.Description: Selects Band Within Core When O_VCO_BAND = 1 (Bit 0).

BitField.Name: M_VCO_CORE
BitField.Description: Selects VCO Core When O_VCO_CORE = 1. 0: VCO 0 highest frequency. 1: VCO 1 lowest frequency.

BitField.Name: INT_MODE
BitField.Description: Integer Mode. 0: fractional mode. 1: integer mode.

BitField.Name: PFD_POL
BitField.Description: PFD Polarity Bit for the Charge Pump.

BitField.Name: M_VCO_BAND_1
BitField.Description: Selects Band Within Core When O_VCO_BAND = 1 (Bits [8:1]).

BitField.Name: BLEED_I_LSB
BitField.Description: Bleed Current (Bits [7:0]). See Charge Pump Bleed Current Optimization.

BitField.Name: EN_REF_RST
BitField.Description: If 1, SW_SYNC or the SYNC pin resets the RDIV and the REF counter.

BitField.Name: TIMED_SYNC
BitField.Description: Retime the synchronization signal with reference input clock.

BitField.Name: BLEED_I_MSB
BitField.Description: Bleed Current (Bits [12:8]). See Charge Pump Bleed Current Optimization.

BitField.Name: BLEED_POL
BitField.Description: Bleed Polarity. 0: current sink. 1: current source.

BitField.Name: REF_CK_FALL
BitField.Description: Timing from rising or falling edge of PFD RCLK. 0: rising edge. 1: falling edge.

BitField.Name: REF_DC_SEL
BitField.Description: Sets polarity of RDIV output before re-time. 00: never invert. 01: always invert. 10: auto 50-67%. 11: auto 33-50%.

Option.Description: 2 = Auto keep high duty cycle between 50% and 67%
3 = Auto keep high duty cycle between 33% and 50%

BitField.Name: DCLK_DIV_SEL
BitField.Description: Selects which bit field controls DIV_NCLK Divider 1. 0: DCLK_DIV1. 1: DNCLK_DIV1.

BitField.Name: DITHER1_SCALE
BitField.Description: Selects the LSB Position for Dither 1.

BitField.Name: PD_ALL
BitField.Description: Main Power Down. 0: normal operation. 1: power down.

BitField.Name: PD_RDIV
BitField.Description: Power-Down the R-Divider. 0: normal. 1: power down.

BitField.Name: PD_NDIV
BitField.Description: Power-Down the N-Divider. 0: normal. 1: power down.

BitField.Name: PD_VCO
BitField.Description: Power-Down the VCO. 0: normal. 1: power down.

BitField.Name: PD_LD
BitField.Description: Power-Down the Lock Detector. 0: normal. 1: power down.

BitField.Name: PD_PFDCP
BitField.Description: Power-Down the PFD Charge Pump. 0: normal. 1: power down.

BitField.Name: PD_RFOUT1
BitField.Description: Power-Down RFOUT1 Output Buffer. 0: normal. 1: power down.

BitField.Name: PD_RFOUT2
BitField.Description: Power-Down RFOUT2 Output Buffer. 0: normal. 1: power down.

BitField.Name: LD_COUNT
BitField.Description: Number of PFD Cycles Before Lock Detector Goes High.

BitField.Name: EN_DNCLK
BitField.Description: Enable DIV_NCLK to the Digital Block. 0: off. 1: on.

BitField.Name: EN_DRCLK
BitField.Description: Enable DIV_RCLK to the Digital Block. 0: off. 1: on.

BitField.Name: EN_LOL
BitField.Description: Enable Loss of Lock Detector. 0: disable. 1: enable.

BitField.Name: EN_LDWIN
BitField.Description: Enable Lock Detector Pulse Window. 0: disabled. 1: enabled.

BitField.Name: RST_LD
BitField.Description: Reset Lock Detector to Unlocked State. 0: inactive. 1: active.

BitField.Name: MUXOUT
BitField.Description: Select Test Signal to MUXOUT. 0000: High-Z. 0001: Lock detect. 0100: fDIV_RCLK/2. 0101: fDIV_NCLK/2. 0111: Logic low. 1000: Logic high.

BitField.Name: EN_CPTEST
BitField.Description: Enable Charge Pump Force Up or Down Test Mode. 0: off. 1: on.

BitField.Name: CP_DOWN
BitField.Description: Force Pump Down Charge Pump Test Mode. 0: off. 1: on.

BitField.Name: CP_UP
BitField.Description: Force Pump Up Charge Pump Test Mode. 0: off. 1: on.

BitField.Name: BST_REF
BitField.Description: Gain boost for low amplitude sinewave reference input.

BitField.Name: FILT_REF
BitField.Description: Select Noise Filter for Sinewave Ref Input Buffer. 0: off. 1: on.

BitField.Name: MUTE_NCLK
BitField.Description: Mutes the N-divider output to digital block.

BitField.Name: REF_SEL
BitField.Description: Select reference input. 0: CML reference input. 1: Sinewave or slow slew-rate.

BitField.Name: INV_RDBLR
BitField.Description: Invert Reference Doubler Output. 0: not inverted. 1: inverted.

BitField.Name: SYNC_DEL
BitField.Description: Sets programmable input delay for synchronization path.

BitField.Name: RST_SYS
BitField.Description: Reset Digital Except SPI and Registers to POR State. 0: inactive. 1: active.

BitField.Name: EN_ADC_CLK
BitField.Description: Enable the ADC Clock. 0: disable. 1: enable.

BitField.Name: DCLK_MODE
BitField.Description: Divide RCLK and NCLK by 2 during VCO calibration. 0: disable. 1: enable.

BitField.Name: DEL_MODE
BitField.Description: Select Adjustment Mode. 0: charge pump bleed mode. 1: Sigma-Delta mode.

BitField.Name: EN_AUTO_ALIGN
BitField.Description: Enable Clock Align Mode. 0: SPI write. 1: DEL_STR and DEL_ADJ pins.

BitField.Name: DRCLK_DEL
BitField.Description: Programmable input delay for digital RCLK path.

BitField.Name: DNCLK_DEL
BitField.Description: Programmable input delay for digital NCLK path.

BitField.Name: RST_CNTR
BitField.Description: Reset for Frequency Counter Test Mode.

BitField.Name: M_VCO_BIAS
BitField.Description: Selects the Bias Value Used When O_VCO_BIAS = 1.

BitField.Name: EN_LUT_CAL
BitField.Description: Enable the Use of the Lookup Table for the Calibration.

BitField.Name: CAL_COUNT_TO
BitField.Description: Timeout value for each VCO calibration decision.

BitField.Name: CAL_VTUNE_TO_0
BitField.Description: Timeout value for VCO VTUNE settling (Bits [7:0]).

BitField.Name: O_VCO_DB
BitField.Description: M_VCO_CORE/BAND/BIAS Double Buffered. 0: not double buffered. 1: double buffered.

BitField.Name: CAL_VTUNE_TO_1
BitField.Description: Timeout value for VCO VTUNE settling (Bits [14:8]).

BitField.Name: CAL_VCO_TO_0
BitField.Description: Timeout for VCO calibration band and core settling (Bits [7:0]).

BitField.Name: DEL_CTRL_DB
BitField.Description: Delay Controls Double Buffered. 0: not double buffered. 1: double buffered.

BitField.Name: CAL_VCO_TO_1
BitField.Description: Timeout for VCO calibration band and core settling (Bits [14:8]).

BitField.Name: CMOS_OV
BitField.Description: Logic High Voltage for MUXOUT, LKDET, SDO, SDIO. 0: 1.8 V. 1: 3.3 V.

BitField.Name: VCAL_ZERO
BitField.Description: Extends range of loop filter component values for VCAL stability.

BitField.Name: REG44_RSV0
BitField.Description: Programmable increasing with temperature component of VCAL.

BitField.Name: REG45_RSV0
BitField.Description: Programmable decreasing with temperature component of VCAL.

BitField.Name: O_VCO_BAND
BitField.Description: Override VCO Band with M_VCO_BAND. 0: from calibration. 1: from M_VCO_BAND.

BitField.Name: O_VCO_CORE
BitField.Description: Override VCO Core with M_VCO_CORE. 0: from calibration. 1: from M_VCO_CORE.

BitField.Name: LUT_SCALE
BitField.Description: Set the scaling factor for the use of the LUT.

BitField.Name: PD_SYNC_MON
BitField.Description: Power down the SYNC setup and hold monitor. 0: normal. 1: power down.

BitField.Name: SYNC_SEL
BitField.Description: Sync input select. 0: CML/PECL input. 1: LVDS input.

BitField.Name: RST_SYNC_MON
BitField.Description: Clear output latch of setup and hold monitor. 0: inactive. 1: active.

BitField.Name: DEL_ADJ
BitField.Description: Delay Adjust Direction Indicator. 0: negative. 1: positive.

BitField.Name: REF_OK
BitField.Description: Reference Input Amplitude Threshold Indicator. 0: below. 1: above.

BitField.Name: ADC_BUSY
BitField.Description: ADC Conversion Status. 0: not in progress. 1: in progress.

BitField.Name: FSM_BUSY
BitField.Description: VCO Calibration Status. 0: not in progress. 1: in progress.

BitField.Name: LOCKED
BitField.Description: Lock Detector Output. 0: not locked. 1: locked.

BitField.Name: CHIP_TEMP_LSB
BitField.Description: Temperature measured by ADC in degrees Celsius (Bits [7:0]).

BitField.Name: DEL_CNT_0
BitField.Description: Bleed code sent to the charge pump (Bits [7:0]).

BitField.Name: DEL_CNT_1
BitField.Description: Bleed code sent to the charge pump (Bits [15:8]).

BitField.Name: FIRST_PASS_VCO_BAND
